dq.title: Catalogue data quality
dq.sourcesHint: Reviewed sources with licence and decision. Public visibility alone does not permit reuse.
dq.caption: Strain catalogue sources with licence, classification and last import
dq.hint: Reproducible validation rules – nothing is changed automatically.

pw.tip: Tip: a passphrase of several random words is long and easy to remember. A password manager is ideal.

rc.confirm: I have stored my login ID and recovery codes safely.
rc.noEmail: Without email there is no other way back.
rc.warning: If you forget your password and lose these codes, your account is lost for good – not even the administration can restore it. Keep the codes separate from the device (password manager or paper).

auth.idA: After creating the account you receive a login ID such as
auth.idB: . You need it to sign in – keep it together with the recovery codes.
auth.tagline: Self-hosted · private data protected · no tracking
auth.createdText: Save your login ID and the recovery codes. They are shown only this one time.
auth.welcomeText: Sign in with your username or account ID.
auth.offline: The server cannot be reached right now.
auth.offlineText: Changes stay on this device until the server has confirmed them.
auth.mfaText: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.mfaHint: No access to the app? Via “Forgot password?” you can sign in with a recovery code – 2FA is then turned off and passkeys are removed.
auth.createText: No email, phone number or real name. Adults only.
auth.inviteBad: This invitation is invalid, expired or already used.
auth.inviteOnly: This instance is invitation-only. You get the link from the administration.
auth.usernameRules: 3–32 characters: lowercase letters, digits, dot, underscore, hyphen. Do not use your real name.
auth.adult: I am of legal age and use TERPGRID within the laws that apply to me.
auth.recoverText: With one of your recovery codes you set a new password. The code is then used up; all sessions are ended, 2FA is turned off and registered passkeys are removed.
auth.noCodes: No codes left? Without a recovery code the account cannot be reset – that is intentional: there is no master key.
